prompt: Summarize this customer complaint email while preserving the customer's main concern and desired resolution, in under 40 words: 'I've been a loyal customer for 5 years, and I'm extremely frustrated that my last three orders arrived damaged. I've contacted support twice with no real resolution. I either need a full refund or a guarantee this won't happen again, or I'll be taking my business elsewhere.'
evaluation_criteria:
Format Compliance: 0-5 (Evaluates whether the specified structure - bullet points, sentence count, audience level - is followed)
Balanced Coverage: 0-5 (Evaluates whether all key points from the source, including any competing or nuanced ones, are represented)
response_text: After five years as a loyal customer, my last three orders arrived damaged and support gave no solution; I demand a full refund or a guarantee against future damage, or I’ll take my business elsewhere.
